description: This PHP class 'FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration' implements plugin and console configuration interfaces for the OrangeHRM system. It initializes class autoloading and registers command-line commands related to database savepoints for functional testing purposes.

classes.name: FunctionalTestingPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin configuration and command registration for functional testing features, including autoloader setup and database savepoint commands.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up class autoloading for the 'OrangeHRM\FunctionalTesting\' namespace and adds a subscriber to the event dispatcher.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers database savepoint commands with the console if the system is not in production mode.
